scenarios.title: Frenzy pumps the attacker only when it is not blocked
decisions: A attacks player B with Frenzy Sliver.
No spells or abilities are used; combat damage is dealt.

variants.label: unblocked
variants.expected: The frenzy trigger fires. Frenzy Sliver is 2/1 until end of turn and deals 2 damage to B (life 18).

variants.label: blocked
variants.delta: B blocks Frenzy Sliver with Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: The frenzy trigger does not fire. Frenzy Sliver stays 1/1, deals 1 damage to Grizzly Bears and dies to its 2 damage. B's life stays 20.

scenarios.forge_notes: Frenzy Sliver gives every Sliver, itself included, an AttackerUnblocked trigger rather than a Frenzy keyword.

scenarios.title: Each instance of frenzy triggers separately
decisions: A attacks player B with the Frenzy Sliver that is not summoning sick.
No spells or abilities are used; combat damage is dealt.

variants.label: two_instances
variants.expected: The attacking Frenzy Sliver has two frenzy 1 instances. Both trigger separately. It is 3/1 until end of turn and deals 3 damage to B (life 17).

variants.label: one_instance
variants.delta: A controls only one Frenzy Sliver (the attacker).
variants.expected: The attacking Frenzy Sliver has one frenzy 1 instance. It triggers once. It is 2/1 until end of turn and deals 2 damage to B (life 18).

variants.label: blocked
variants.delta: B blocks the attacking Frenzy Sliver with Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Neither frenzy instance triggers. The attacker stays 1/1, deals 1 damage to Grizzly Bears and dies. B's life stays 20.

scenarios.forge_notes: Each Frenzy Sliver grants the trigger to every Sliver, so two of them give the attacker two separate triggers; confirm Forge does not merge identical granted triggers.
